user.title: BMS controller setup
user.description: Select the entities used for weather-compensated heating control. Each weather influence can have its own sensor; where none is selected, the weather entity is used. The sun position is calculated from the Home Assistant location.

data_description.target_thermostat: Thermostat whose target temperature the controller will set.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Outdoor temperature sensor — primary source for the heating curve.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Source of the forecast (curve and influences) and of current influences without their own sensor.
data_description.wind_sensor: Optional. Takes precedence over the weather entity's wind; the unit is converted to km/h.
data_description.rain_sensor: Optional. Preferably precipitation intensity (mm/h); takes precedence over the weather entity.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Relative humidity in %; takes precedence over the weather entity.
data_description.clouds_sensor: Optional. Cloud coverage in % (0 = clear, 100 = overcast); takes precedence over the weather entity.

reconfigure.title: Change BMS controller entities
reconfigure.description: Change the entities used by the controller. A cleared field is removed. Profiles, curve and settings are kept.

data_description.target_thermostat: Thermostat whose target temperature the controller will set.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Outdoor temperature sensor — primary source for the heating curve.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Source of the forecast (curve and influences) and of current influences without their own sensor.
data_description.wind_sensor: Optional. Takes precedence over the weather entity's wind; the unit is converted to km/h.
data_description.rain_sensor: Optional. Preferably precipitation intensity (mm/h); takes precedence over the weather entity.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Relative humidity in %; takes precedence over the weather entity.
data_description.clouds_sensor: Optional. Cloud coverage in % (0 = clear, 100 = overcast); takes precedence over the weather entity.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The BMS controller is already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Control settings
init.description: The same values are available as device entities and in the card. Curve profiles are not changed.

data.safe_curve_temp: Heating when the outdoor temperature is unavailable
data.sun_forecast: Sun influence: use the sun position after the horizon

data_description.curve_forecast_hours: The curve uses the forecast outdoor temperature this many hours ahead. Matches the building's thermal inertia, usually 2–6 h.
data_description.sun_mode: Fixed window = only between the solar window azimuths (shifts against sunrise and sunset during the year). Window direction = by the angle of incidence on the windows. Whole day = the whole time above the horizon, relative to today's noon.
data_description.sun_orientation: Used in the Window direction mode: 90° = east, 180° = south, 270° = west.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded, settings cannot be changed.

not_loaded.message: The BMS controller integration is not loaded.

invalid_curve_points.message: The heating curve needs at least 2 points with x and y values.

missing_thermostat.title: BMS controller thermostat not found
missing_thermostat.description: Entity {entity_id} was not found, so the controller cannot set the temperature. Fix it via Settings → Devices & services → BMS controller → Reconfigure.

missing_outdoor_sensor.title: BMS controller outdoor sensor not found
missing_outdoor_sensor.description: Entity {entity_id} was not found. The controller uses the weather temperature or the safe temperature instead. Fix it via Reconfigure.

missing_weather.title: BMS controller weather entity not found
missing_weather.description: Entity {entity_id} was not found, weather influences and the forecast are unavailable. Fix it via Reconfigure.

missing_influence_sensor.title: BMS controller weather influence sensor not found
missing_influence_sensor.description: Entity {entity_id} was not found. The influence falls back to the weather entity if one is configured. Fix or remove the sensor via Reconfigure.

save_profile.name: Save profile
save_profile.description: Saves the current seasonal settings (curve, influences, night mode, frost protection, boost) as a named profile. Integration settings (limits, recalculation interval, bypass) are not stored in profiles.

name.name: Name
name.description: Profile name (new or existing one to overwrite).

load_profile.name: Load profile
load_profile.description: Applies a stored profile to the seasonal entities. Integration settings stay unchanged.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the profile to load.

delete_profile.name: Delete profile
delete_profile.description: Permanently removes a profile from storage.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the profile to delete.

rename_profile.name: Rename profile
rename_profile.description: Renames a profile and updates quick profiles and schedule rules.

set_curve_points.name: Set curve points
set_curve_points.description: Stores the complete list of heating curve points.

points.name: Points
points.description: List of points [{x: float, y: float}, ...], at least 2, sorted by x.

get_curve_points.name: Get curve points
get_curve_points.description: Returns the current curve points and storage state and fires the heating_curve_curve_response event.

retry_storage.name: Retry storage
retry_storage.description: Tries to write the in-memory curve points to storage again (after a failure).

activate_boost.name: Activate boost
activate_boost.description: Temporarily raises the heating temperature by the given °C for the given number of hours.

activate_reduction.name: Activate reduction
activate_reduction.description: Temporarily lowers the heating temperature by the given °C for the given number of hours.

cancel_boost.name: Cancel boost / reduction
cancel_boost.description: Immediately ends an active boost or reduction.

force_refresh.name: Force refresh
force_refresh.description: Immediately recalculates weather, influences and the resulting heating temperature, sets the thermostat and writes a calculation log entry.

set_starred.name: Set quick profiles
set_starred.description: Sets the list of starred (quick) profiles shown in the card.

save_schedule.name: Save schedule rule
save_schedule.description: Adds or updates an automatic profile switching rule.

type.name: Type
type.description: Rule type: date (date range) or temp (temperature condition).

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile activated when the condition is met.

date_from.name: Date from
date_from.description: Start date in MM-DD format (for type date).

date_to.name: Date to
date_to.description: End date in MM-DD format (for type date).

temp_op.name: Operator
temp_op.description: Comparison operator for the temperature condition: < or >.

temp_val.name: Threshold
temp_val.description: Threshold temperature for the temperature condition (°C).

temp_days.name: Days
temp_days.description: The condition must hold for at least this many days (average).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the rule is active (default yes).

delete_schedule.name: Delete schedule rule
delete_schedule.description: Removes an automatic profile switching rule by its ID.

id.name: ID
id.description: ID of the rule to delete.

reorder_schedules.name: Reorder schedule rules
reorder_schedules.description: Changes the evaluation order of the automatic profile switching rules.

order.name: Order
order.description: List of rule IDs in the new order.
